_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. Not a certification. Worked example of release-artifact.schema.json v1 for the certified baseline: Oracle running image 8400deecf2a9 fingerprinted to source 099927152b93e0de7c1a120bc88d73fb939c1502 (provenance lane, 2026-09-19, confidence HIGH). Digests below are illustrative placeholders except where noted; a real artifact carries measured values.

baseline.note: Certified baseline of record. Provenance lane: container files EXACT sha256 match to the Oracle release tarball; tarball STRONG_MATCH to the commit after CRLF normalization. Rollback target until a newer release completes the full sequence.

canonicalEventWrite.detail: authenticated POST /events -> HTTP 200; event persisted to ping_events

containerBuild.detail: image built for linux/arm64 from the exact snapshot

dedup.detail: re-POST returned identical event_id; no new row

missionPath.detail: MISSION_CREATED -> ASSIGNED -> STARTED -> COMPLETED with CLAIM_CREATED + OBSERVATION_CREATED evidence

postRestartRead.detail: event, mission, and evidence recoverable after restart

provenanceLabels.detail: REQUIREMENT going forward (design only in Lane C; deployment agent implements): OCI labels org.opencontainers.image.revision/.source/.created on every PING image; /health or build-info surface exposes non-secret source_sha / image identity / runtime version. The baseline image predates this requirement: it was built from a non-git tarball with no labels, so its SHA was reconstructed by forensics (capturedAtBuild=false).
provenanceLabels.summary: provenance labels predate the requirement on the baseline image

readiness.detail: /health 200 READY within the bounded startup window

rollbackProof.detail: rollback image retagged and verified healthy BEFORE the candidate swap

provenance.note: Baseline gap, recorded honestly: the certified image's source SHA was reconstructed by forensics afterward (non-git tarball build, no OCI labels, unknown build/deploy commands). Going forward capturedAtBuild must be true.

deploymentPhase.rollbackImageDigest: sha256:<rollback image digest recorded BEFORE the swap>

distribution.manifestDigest: sha256:<measured over the exact build-context snapshot>

eventIdentity.certificationNote: CERTIFICATION.md amendment 2026-09-18: Event Identity certification WITHDRAWN (F7 falsified). Declared versions are source truth only.

sourceSha.detail: sha=099927152b93e0de7c1a120bc88d73fb939c1502 branch=constitutional-convergence-v2 dirty=false repository=https://github.com/ngesk2/crx-runtime.git chain=ping-runtime confidence=HIGH (captured at certification time from git)

source.confidenceNote: captured at certification time from git on a clean tree

verdict.note: all pre-promotion gates PASS and deployment-phase gates COMPLETE; release certified

witnessReplay.certificationNote: CERTIFICATION.md: witness NOT CERTIFIED (9 implementations, 3 live/reachable, incompatible formats, zero persisted).
